detail: The fasting Day 1 means and SEMs of glucose and insulin (Table 5) are the entry the batch asks for, and they are printed only as 'Raw means ± SEMs' over the analysed sample of 18 with no n for any column, while the Methods analyse 'all available data from participants completing 2 or 3 periods', so the n behind each cell is not given anywhere in the paper; the post-meal curves are figure-only and the fibre-arm differences need a fibre type the model lacks, so n is the one piece that would let a finding file be written.
